request.text_style_prompt: Two enormous dark bat wings of the original Might and Magic 6 flying devil. Thin dark charcoal-brown leathery translucent-looking opaque membranes, very dark almost black outside, desaturated grey-purple subtle mottling inside, dense branching fine veins, stretched wrinkled leather between long dark bony finger struts, scars and irregular weathering. The membranes are much darker than purple demon skin. Matte nonmetallic natural tissue, no pink skin, no bright flesh, no gold, no armour, no fabric, no eyes, no decoration. Preserve every membrane and finger shape and the original UVs.

creature: MM6 Flying Demon A/B/C / native wdm / descriptors 499,500,501
scope: Complete derivative production from selected walking demon: study, corrected body, wings and rig, all native actions, UV/PBR A/B/C textures and verified editable/portable exports. Runtime installation is separate.

required_components.attachment: Inherited 77-joint repaired body rig; normalized weights; tail and clasp controls removed.
Wing_Left_Root parented to mixamorig:Spine2; six independent wing joints.
Wing_Right_Root parented to mixamorig:Spine2; six independent wing joints.
Separate 8-morph soft-alpha plume synchronized with Death; living presentation parent hides at 0.500 s.
Separate ground-level held mesh, visible only in Ash_Remains.

correction_ledger.change: Reused the original surface, smoothed the raised harness, exact-unioned only the principal body shell; transferred new-vertex weights by source-triangle barycentric interpolation.

correction_ledger.cause: 197 torso vertices used the deleted clasp bone, with five tiny pendant-hinge leftovers.
correction_ledger.change: Transferred residual influence to Spine1 and normalized; retained jaw/eyes/ears as independently articulated parts.

correction_ledger.cause: Guessed projected wrist targets exceeded fixed chain reach.
correction_ledger.change: Revised targets and fixed-length chain fitting in the correct rest/parent spaces; stable elbow/knee poles.

correction_ledger.cause: Source scene included preview/effect/remains objects outside the selected assembly.
correction_ledger.change: Filtered delivery to the 19 intended meshes, one rig, synchronized native clips and presentation nodes.

correction_ledger.cause: Forearm twist and guessed world palm roll disagreed near the crossing rake.
correction_ledger.change: Native-anchor local wrist quaternions, hemisphere continuity and distributed forearm twist; unchanged bone length/scale.

correction_ledger.cause: Edge faces crossed the front/back membrane charts.
correction_ledger.change: Recharted 104 rim triangles per wing in 52 padded cells; retained geometry and weights.

correction_ledger.cause: Body-colour retexture painted skin on the membranes.
correction_ledger.change: Separate 10-credit wing-only dark-leather texture return; retained body palette maps.

correction_ledger.cause: Inherited grounded presentation put talons too close to floor during airborne clips.
correction_ledger.change: Raised the living presentation by 0.16 m and reviewed every Flight/Attack/Hit sample.

correction_ledger.cause: Tetrahedra and the following closed tongue trials looked like fragments or droplets.
correction_ledger.change: 580 soft-alpha flame tongues, each three crossed ribbons, eight native-derived morphs and explicit state resets.

correction_ledger.cause: Six small overlap pairs remained after exact union.
correction_ledger.change: Assigned the 12 affected triangles unique reserved charts; full atlas overlap check.

correction_ledger.cause: Service welded near-coincident Boolean seam vertices and retriangulated small slivers.
correction_ledger.change: Measured <0.1 mm position and <0.5 texel UV deviations; transferred only verified maps to the retained animated master.

correction_ledger.cause: Nondefault Blender specular setting exported KHR_materials_specular unsupported by the consumer.
correction_ledger.change: Used supported core PBR factors, nonmetal skin/leather/bone and plain glTF BLEND flame.

correction_ledger.finding: Hit bank and soles at source C
correction_ledger.cause: Wing banking was reversed and raised foot pointed down.
correction_ledger.change: Matched viewer-left high/viewer-right low wings and front-facing raised sole; reviewed dense five-view poses.

correction_ledger.finding: Death chest occlusion and source D
correction_ledger.cause: Plume depth lay behind the chest and source-D arms remained high.
correction_ledger.change: Moved plume across the chest, lowered D hands around pelvis, drooped wings; kept body disappearance at native E, 0.500 s.

user_acceptance.scope: New Flying Demon derivative, all three palettes and native motions; inherited additional finger is not an accepted deviation.

next_action.action: Review the staged creature on index.html; report animation, frame, view and region for any artistic changes. Runtime installation remains a separate request.

documented_inferences: Four long fingers plus thumb are retained from the walking-demon rig; native sprites show three dominant long fingers. The obscured additional finger is an inference and is not user-accepted.
Attack, Hit and Death have one front bitmap per source phase reused for every direction. Depth, palm roll, joint poles, wing articulation and alternate-view poses are extrapolated.
Death is native-derived soft-alpha crossed flame ribbons with morphs, not a recovered fluid simulation. The front plume envelope follows the sprites; its depth is inferred.
Right appearance is mirrored inference from the existing HD reference set. No new reference generation or replacement body remesh was needed.
All production assets and engine loader/pose checks are complete; user artistic acceptance and in-game GPU appearance/installation are separate.
